sn2.8:1.2: Atha kho Tāyano devaputto purāṇatitthakaro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi ||
sn2.8:1.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Tāyano devaputto Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || || 2.
sn2.8:7.2: idaṃ vatvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 4.
sn2.8:8.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi || || 5.
sn2.8:8.2: Imaṃ bhikkhavo rattiṃ Tāyano nāma devaputto purāṇatitthakaro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā mam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi ||
sn2.8:8.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Tāyano devaputto mama santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || || 6.
sn2.8:14.1: Idam avoca bhikkhave Tāyano devaputto || idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyi ||
sn2.8:14.5: atthasaṃhitā bhikkhave Tāyanagāthā ādibrahmacariyikāti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || ||
